CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ace.audit_cbt_policy()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'ace'
AS $function$
begin
 insert into ace.audit_events(actor_user_id,event_type,entity_type,metadata)
 values(auth.uid(),'cbt_policy_changed',tg_table_name,jsonb_build_object('operation',tg_op,
  'before',case when tg_op<>'INSERT' then to_jsonb(old) else null end,
  'after',case when tg_op<>'DELETE' then to_jsonb(new) else null end));
 if tg_op='DELETE' then return old; end if;
 return new;
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ace.can_manage_catalog()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'ace', 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from ace.roles
    where user_id = auth.uid()
      and role in ('admin', 'editor')
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ace.check_catalog_import_idempotency(p_snapshot_hash text)

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'ace'
AS $function$
 select b.id,b.status,b.row_count from ace.catalog_import_batches b
 where auth.uid() is not null and ace.is_admin_or_editor() and b.snapshot_hash=p_snapshot_hash
 limit 1;

functions.name: get_active_exam_blueprint
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ace.get_active_exam_blueprint()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'ace'
AS $function$
select coalesce((
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'season', to_jsonb(s),
    'config', to_jsonb(c),
    'subjects', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cs) order by cs.sort_order, cs.subject_id) from ace.exam_config_subjects cs where cs.exam_config_id=c.id),'[]'::jsonb)
  )
  from ace.exam_seasons s
  join ace.exam_configs c on c.season_id=s.id and c.active=true
  where s.status='active'
  order by s.exam_year desc, c.version desc
  limit 1
),'{}'::jsonb);
$function$

functions.name: guard_attempt_snapshot
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ace.guard_attempt_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'ace'
AS $function$
begin
 if new.question_snapshot is distinct from old.question_snapshot
    or new.question_order is distinct from old.question_order
    or new.option_order is distinct from old.option_order then
  raise exception 'Attempt paper is immutable' using errcode='23514';
 end if;
 return new;
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ace.guard_mock_provenance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'ace'
AS $function$
begin
 if old.exam_config_id is not null and
    (new.exam_config_id is distinct from old.exam_config_id
     or new.exam_config_snapshot is distinct from old.exam_config_snapshot
     or new.duration_seconds is distinct from old.duration_seconds
     or new.mode is distinct from old.mode) then
  raise exception 'Mock configuration is immutable' using errcode='23514';
 end if;
 return new;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ace.has_active_entitlement(p_user_id uuid, p_product_code text DEFAULT 'ace_pass'::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'ace'
AS $function$
 select auth.uid() is not null
   and (p_user_id = auth.uid() or ace.is_admin())
   and exists (
     select 1 from ace.entitlements e join ace.products p on p.id=e.product_id
     where e.user_id=p_user_id and p.code=p_product_code and e.status='active'
       and now() >= e.starts_at and now() < e.ends_at
   );
$function$

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ace.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'ace', 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from ace.roles where user_id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin');
$function$

functions.name: is_admin_or_editor
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ace.is_admin_or_editor()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'ace', 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from ace.roles where user_id = auth.uid() and role in ('admin','editor'));
$function$

functions.name: is_syllabus_version_public
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ace.is_syllabus_version_public(p_syllabus_version_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'ace'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from ace.syllabus_versions sv
    where sv.id = p_syllabus_version_id
      and sv.status = 'active'
      and sv.rights_status = 'approved'
  );
$function$
